## Question-1
The message that git gives is "Already up to date."
This is because, as we try to pull from the public repo, all the changes made
there have already been applied here.

## Question-2
"install.packages()" should go in the console because I am installing the
package(s) to my computer, not the document.

## Question-3
"library()" should go in the .qmd document so that the package can be loaded in
for use in the document.
